proposedEntry.name: algorithmic-art
proposedEntry.description: Directs the agent to create generative p5.js art in two steps: write a named algorithmic-philosophy manifesto (computational process, noise/particle/field approach, seeded variation) as a .md file, then implement it as a single self-contained interactive HTML artifact built from a required starting template that fixes the Anthropic-branded sidebar UI (seed navigation, parameter sliders, color pickers, action buttons) while leaving the p5.js algorithm, parameters, and controls fully custom to the philosophy. Enforces reproducibility via explicit randomSeed/noiseSeed usage.
triggers: build a flow field or particle system artifact
create an interactive seeded art piece
inputs: a subtle creative brief or theme to interpret
no real content required -- the skill invents the algorithmic direction
outputs: a single self-contained interactive HTML artifact (p5.js algorithm + seed/parameter/color controls) usable directly in a browser or as a claude.ai artifact
